pages.title: Base Stats
pages.text:
The Wild Sculk Doll is a hostile boss summoned from the Sculk Shrine. Its stats are higher than those of ordinary mobs:

• HP: 300
• Attack: 10 (melee)
• Move speed: 0.3
• Slow regeneration
• Full knockback resistance, cannot be knocked back
• Immune to fire and lava damage
• Immune to all projectile damage (arrows, tridents, wither skulls, etc.)

It attacks every creature that is not in Creative or Spectator mode, and counter-attacks immediately after being hit.

pages.title: Sonic Attack
pages.text:
When the player is outside melee range, the Wild Sculk Doll charges and fires a sonic attack:

• Sonic damage: 6 (armor-piercing)
• Charge-up: 1.5s (with a sound cue)
• Fire cooldown: 7s
• Range: 32 blocks
• Pull: drags the player 15% closer to it

pages.title: Spawn Sequence & Drops
pages.text:
When summoned, the Wild Sculk Doll slowly rises from the shrine (about 5 seconds) with smoke and soul-flame particles, and is invulnerable during this time.

Defeating it has a 60% chance to drop a Sculk Doll Head (+10% per level of Looting). Use the head to craft the Sculk Doll Egg and tame it.
